name: Amamigunto National Park
description: National park (2017) of the Amami islands with their subtropical laurel forests, rare wildlife (Amami rabbit), and coral reefs at the edge of the East China Sea.
notes: Designated 2017 (42,196 ha). The Amami-Oshima forest trails and the island beaches are the core.
parking: Parking available at major visitor areas (fee varies)

ja.description: 奄美群島の亜熱帯照葉樹林、アマミノクロウサギなどの希少生物、東シナ海に広がるサンゴ礁を擁する国立公園（2017年指定）です。
highlights: アマミノクロウサギの生息地
